title: repo-guardian Helm chart values
description: Subset of values.yaml that is enforced at `helm install`/`helm upgrade` time. IMPL-0016 added schema-level rejection of the removed memory / ticker backend identifiers so operators see schema errors at chart-render time instead of pod CrashLoopBackoff.

maxJobAttempts.description: Deliveries a job may accumulate (deferrals + reaper requeues) before it is dropped with a terminal repo_state error (IMPL-0022). Must be >= 1; the binary rejects 0 at startup.

backend.description: Persistent state store backend. Only "postgres" is supported since IMPL-0016 (chart 1.0).
Work queue backend. Only "valkey" is supported since IMPL-0016 (chart 1.0).
Sweep scheduler backend. Only "valkey" is supported since IMPL-0016 (chart 1.0).

discovery.description: Repository discovery (IMPL-0015 Phase 1) — periodic enumeration of installations + repos via the GitHub API into Store.UpsertIfMissing.

posture.description: Compliance posture export (IMPL-0023 / DESIGN-0022) — the leader projects rule_state onto the posture gauges.

exportInterval.description: Go duration (e.g. "60s", "5m"). Costs no GitHub API budget; tuned against gauge staleness.
